abstract.p: The invention provides oral terpene cyclodextrin inclusion complex delivery vehicles, including formulations in which the cyclodextrin inclusion complex is provided together with enzyme having a cyclodextrin-degrading activity capable of digesting the cyclodextrin, so that upon delivery of the vehicle to a target the enzyme is activated and releases the guest molecule from the cyclodextrin cavity. In alternative aspects, these cyclodextrin inclusion complex delivery vehicles are for example provided in the form of time release formulations, for example for treatment of airway mucus dysfunction. Formulations are also provided with erectogenic efficacy.
